description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Wind], [Wind Drain] and [Gale Spear Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Wind Drain
description.text: Restores HP for 10% of the damage dealt with Wind attacks

description.name: Gale Spear Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Gale Spear after using a Wind ability
